goal: Same recipe + same seed + same project assets must produce the same logical KDP activity in FPP and FPM.
rules: FPP and FPM are two UIs of one Fenix product model.
UI may differ; project, recipe, asset and solution semantics may not.
Windows, Linux and mobile must read the same portable project model.
Never add a Studio capability to only one frontend without bumping its module contract.
Newer module versions must not be silently interpreted by an older frontend.
Shared renderers should be byte-identical where practical.
KDP production correctness takes priority over cosmetic parity.
